en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> the varieties (of food) enlarges the belly, and numbs the buttocks’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following:
’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Eating many kinds of foods at the same time enlarges the belly and numbs the buttocks.’”
